text: Where do the sensors go? Inside the hull, right behind the magnet dock.
The dock is glued on the outside. The plug's magnet points straight through the wall, with its south pole facing the hull.
On the inside of the wall, mark a small cross where the dock's axis comes through.
The printed bracket goes on that cross. Its small window sits on the axis, the two posts hold the Hall module, and the rails hold the reed contact.
The A3144 Hall chip lies flat in the window, with its printed face against the wall. Its legs run down the channel to the KY-003 board, which screws onto the two posts.
Slide the MC-38 into the rails, long side pointing at the axis. Its end holds the Hall chip flat. Two cable ties lock it in place.
Run a twisted three-wire cable from the Hall module to J3, and a two-wire cable from the reed to J4. Keep both at least ten centimetres from the battery wires.
Now switch on and push the plug in. Slide the bracket until both blue LEDs stay on, mark the spot, and glue it with epoxy.
Test it. Pull the plug, and both LEDs go off. Push it back in, and they light up again.
